title: The Living Gods
notes: The Holy Knight's prayers now call on the living gods by their true names: Celmiss, the Mother (Dawn's Mercy, Dawnbreak), Cevel, the Judge (Iron Verdict, Chains of Cevel), Gaeliel, the Storm King (Wrath of Gaeliel, Gaeliel's Embrace), Gulthus, god of the Dead (Gulthus's Bargain, Grave Tide) and Delthius, god of Fortunes (Delthius's Gamble). The prayers work exactly as before.

Items named for the gods follow, including ones you already own: Echo of Gulthus, Delthius's Loaded Die, Gaeliel's Captive Storm, Splinter of the Storm King, Banner of the Judge and the Judge's Bolt Case.
The god waiting at the summit is the Pretender: the false god who raised the mountain over the Tree of Life.
